statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Claude"'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // ""'); used_ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); rate_limit=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); branch=$(git --no-optional-locks -C "$dir" rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); out="$model"; [ -n "$dir" ] && out="$out | $(basename "$dir")"; [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out ($branch)"; if [ -n "$used_ctx" ]; then val=$(printf '%.0f' "$used_ctx"); if [ "$val" -ge 90 ]; then ctx_str="\u001b[1;31mcontext: ${val}%\u001b[0m"; elif [ "$val" -ge 70 ]; then ctx_str="\u001b[33mcontext: ${val}%\u001b[0m"; else ctx_str="context: ${val}%"; fi; out="$out | $ctx_str"; fi; if [ -n "$rate_limit" ]; then val=$(printf '%.0f' "$rate_limit"); if [ "$val" -ge 90 ]; then lim_str="\u001b[1;31mlimit: ${val}%\u001b[0m"; elif [ "$val" -ge 70 ]; then lim_str="\u001b[33mlimit: ${val}%\u001b[0m"; else lim_str="limit: ${val}%"; fi; out="$out | $lim_str"; fi; echo -e "$out"
